name: kanban-4
title: Personal Task Lanes
description: Personal my-tasks kanban with Today, This Week, and Later lanes of compact rows you drag and drop to reprioritize.

standards.purpose: Move work between stages by dragging or an equivalent keyboard path.
useWhen: Items have a small set of ordered stages and change stage often.
doNotUseWhen: The workflow has many stages or needs history auditing (use a table or timeline).

rules.check: Every drag action has a keyboard equivalent that announces the new position.
Each column is labelled with its stage and shows its item count.
A moved card shows pending state and visibly reverts if saving fails.
